newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bank shares rise on rate cut hopes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bank shares rise on rate cut hopes.

text.p: Shares in Australia's Big Four banks reached new highs on Monday as traders priced in the rally in U.S. bonds and hopes of another local interest rate cut.

National Australia Bank Ltd, up 16 cents at A$16.01, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, up 17 cents at A$12.92, and Westpac Banking Corp, up 11 cents at A$7.61, all set record highs while Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd remained near the top of its range, rising 10 cents to A$8.14.
